notes.title: Update 1!
notes.content:
Hi!

I've got a few feature request/changes and some of you reported some bugs.
Here a short list, what I have done :


     Jump Height Control. It is now possible to press long on the jump key to perform a higher jump, or to press short on the jump key to jump pretty low.
     A maximum velocity on wall jumps against ultra speed.  
     Additionally to the master sound slider, there are now also slider for music and sound.
     A rubber in the leveleditor, so you can remove tiles and entities at the same time.
     The race-multiplayer maps are now easier. Furthermore, you can now only shoot balls instead of bullets in the race.
     Multiple language support. For the time being german is now supported, however it is pretty easy to add more languages. If you are interested in translating into another language, mail me. You will get a reward for a nice translation.
     Spiky Trees are now slower so it is easier to pass them, since this was the hardest thing to pass (from what I have seen in Let's Plays and exprience reports)
     Fixed a couple of other issues.


Hope you like the update! If you have any requests or find bugs, write it in the community hub or mail me!
